description:
Advances: specled.mix_tasks, specled.prime, specled.next

PRECONDITION: specled_-pzd release PR merged to main; epic branch specled_-hj4/spec-check-verdict-contract fast-forwarded/rebased onto post-pzd main before starting.

Deliverable:
Verdict contract in task stdout (refined plan Stage 1 — /Users/mz/vaults/rmbrs-vault/plans/src-specled_ex/2026-07-24-spec-check-verdict-contract/runs/20260724-142413-claude-mini/05-refined-plan.md):
1. Trailing verdict line on EVERY path, stdout, printed before any Mix.raise, as the last stdout line and the only line starting with the task name: `spec.check result=pass` | `spec.check result=fail tier=<validate|branch> error_findings=<N>`; analogous `spec.validate result=…` in spec.validate. Exit-code semantics unchanged (Mix.raise calls stay).
2. Tier-label the structural line: `status=…` -> `validate status=… errors=… warnings=…` (spec.check.ex ~:106, spec.validate.ex ~:88). Rename in place, NOT keep-and-add — compatibility inventory in the refined plan proved the only stdout parser is this repo's own test file.
3. Branch findings summary gains severity breakdown + info-suppression disclosure: `findings=<N> (error=<E> warning=<W> info=<I>, info hidden; --verbose to show)`; `… info shown)` variant when verbose/SPECLED_SHOW_INFO active (print_branch_report ~:229).
4. ERROR-last display ordering in print_branch_report and print_validation_findings (display-only sort; report map and record_evidence untouched).
5. Read-protocol sentence appended where prime/next suggest spec.check: prime.ex default_loop/2 BOTH clauses (~:64,:73, in the step string below hashed format_human/1); next.ex format_human/2 suggested_commands rendering (~:55-56, not realization-hashed). Protocol wording verbatim (reused across all surfaces): "The last line is the verdict — `spec.check result=…`; nothing above it, including `validate status=…`, is the verdict."
No new module for the verdict printer: keep print_verdict as a private helper duplicated in each task module (a new lib/ file matches no subject surface and trips uncovered_frontier_change). api_boundary safety: only run/1 is realization-hashed per task file — edit run/1 in place (expected drift; regen baseline), APPEND new helpers at module end below validate_min_strength!/1, never insert above run/1.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: test/mix/tasks/spec_tasks_test.exs — (a) green run: intermediate line is `validate status=pass errors=0 warnings=0` AND last stdout message is exactly `spec.check result=pass`; (b) validate-tier fail (existing strict-findings test ~:572): captured messages contain `spec.check result=fail tier=validate error_findings=<N>` as last stdout message before the raise; (c) branch-tier fail (existing missing-subject-update test ~:386, the motivating incident): `validate status=pass…` present AND NOT the verdict, breakdown line shows `(error=<E> warning=<W> info=<I>, info hidden; --verbose to show)`, [ERROR] lines print after [WARNING]/[INFO], last stdout message is `spec.check result=fail tier=branch error_findings=<E>`; (d) spec.validate verdict pair (green + fail). Update the four existing `status=…` assertions (~:179,:266,:615,:751) to `validate status=…`. Suggestion-text asserts in test/mix/tasks/spec_prime_task_test.exs and spec_next_task_test.exs (protocol sentence present in loop/commands output).
- Behaviors to demonstrate: scenarios for the two new mix_tasks requirements (specled.tasks.verdict_line, specled.tasks.branch_findings_breakdown) + prime/next read-protocol requirements (specled.prime.verdict_read_protocol, specled.next.verdict_read_protocol) — authored in this stage's spec amendments; flip stubs to execute:true as tests land.
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: compile-graph-scoped checks only (mix test --stale or named files) plus mix spec.check --no-run-commands; no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: immediately before IMPLEMENTED, full merge-gate list run-until-green: mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused && mix spec.check (bare). Judge spec.check by exit status + zero ERROR branch findings, not the status line.
  - Verifier tier: flipped stubs and targeted/--stale selections only; no full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test exercising that production path
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test (pass/validate-fail/branch-fail paths; verbose/non-verbose breakdown variants)
  - Known diff-independent flake signatures (do NOT attribute to this diff): scenario_refactor_stable_test realization-drift (specled_-l05); store_test shared-$TMPDIR last_run.status pollution (specled_-26g)
- Call-site Integration: production callers are Mix.Tasks.Spec.Check.run/1 and Mix.Tasks.Spec.Validate.run/1 (verdict printer, tier label, breakdown, ordering) and SpecLedEx.Prime default-loop step + SpecLedEx.Next.format_human/2 (protocol text); proven by the named task tests above which drive the real tasks.

- docs/**, README.md, skills/**, .spec/AGENTS.md, .claude/rules/**
- .spec/specs/package.spec.md
- lib/specled_ex/coverage/**, lib/specled_ex/review/**, lib/specled_ex/case.ex

- No new lib/ module for the verdict printer (deliberate duplication)
- Display-only ordering: do not reorder findings in the report map or evidence
- No keep-and-add duplicate status line — rename in place per compatibility inventory
- No docs/CHANGELOG changes (S2)

Merge gate:
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly (--warnings-as-errors)
- [ ] Tests listed above pass
- [ ] Spec verification passes (mix spec.check bare — exit 0, zero ERROR branch findings)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
